_readme: THE MODEL'S ENTRY — locked, versioned, committed. Regenerate only by running
scripts/build-model-picks.ts by hand. Never at build time.
Eight division winners and the Super Bowl champion, and nothing else. Every
number is the share of full simulated seasons — remaining schedule plus the
complete playoff bracket — in which that team won the thing.

simulation.method: Elo Monte Carlo. Each replay plays every remaining regular-season game, then the full seven-team-per-conference bracket — wild card, divisional, conference title, and a neutral-site Super Bowl — with ratings updating inside the replay as it goes.

nfc_west.basis: won NFC West in 57% of 10,000 simulated seasons, ahead of San Francisco 49ers on 29%

afc_west.basis: won AFC West in 53% of 10,000 simulated seasons, ahead of Los Angeles Chargers on 24%

afc_south.basis: won AFC South in 49% of 10,000 simulated seasons, ahead of Jacksonville Jaguars on 33%

afc_east.basis: won AFC East in 48% of 10,000 simulated seasons, ahead of New England Patriots on 36%

nfc_east.basis: won NFC East in 50% of 10,000 simulated seasons, ahead of Dallas Cowboys on 18%

afc_north.basis: won AFC North in 39% of 10,000 simulated seasons, ahead of Pittsburgh Steelers on 26%

nfc_north.basis: won NFC North in 30% of 10,000 simulated seasons, ahead of Minnesota Vikings on 28%

nfc_south.basis: won NFC South in 31% of 10,000 simulated seasons, ahead of Atlanta Falcons on 29%

sb_champ.basis: lifted the trophy in 15% of 10,000 full playthroughs — every remaining game plus the whole bracket — ahead of Denver Broncos on 8%
